plan.notes: AAS in Paramedicine 'Course Sequence by Term' as published in the official 2026-2027 MCC pathway map (Academic Plan Code 3889, effective Fall 2026), retrieved 2026-10-01. Sequenced sum = 73 (15+15+13+16+14), within the catalog Total Credits Required range of 69.5-77.5. PME206 and PME289 are printed with no credit value in the map and are seeded at 0 (excluded from the total), documented here. The 'Select two of the following courses' PME202-or-PME203-or-PME204 row appears twice verbatim in Term 4; kept verbatim per the catalog-duplicate convention (pipeline exclusion accepted). Admission: students must be current and in good standing as AZ DHS Bureau of Emergency Medical Services-certified EMTs (EMT certification preparatory courses are not sequenced in this map). Students must earn a grade of C or better in all courses, and a grade of B or better in all PME courses.
